text: Carpentry is the ancient art and craft of building structures using wood and other materials. An essential component of carpentry is varnish, which provides a protective and decorative finish to wooden surfaces. Varnish enhances the overall look and durability of wooden furniture and wooden structures alike. Before varnish application, joints must be properly sealed and dry, ensuring a strong bond and smooth finishing. Once joints are joined and dried, varnish is applied to protect and preserve the wood, adding a shiny and elegant finish to the finished piece. Through meticulous attention to joint work and consistent varnish application, carpenters create lasting and beautiful works of art.
